And There are only 20973 fragments been processed.

It's very strange.

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: reads after trimming
parts:
Hi Felix,

Cutadapt seems to work for dna-seq data, not rna-seq data. You may ask the developers of Cutadapt if it is suitable for trimming rna-seq data.

subjunc automatically deals with the adapter sequences. It uses the maximal mappable regions of each read to find mapping location of the read. So you do not need to trim them.

Hope this helps.

Wei
